name: Swift Creek Trading Co
old_description: Over the years it built a solid business around Western Clothing, Footwear and Tack.
about:
Swift Creek Trading Co. operates from Afton, Wyoming, a small town on the route to Yellowstone and Jackson Hole. The business was established in 1990 by Michael Horn, who remains the owner and operator. Horn describes the shop as his "fantasy factory," opening early and closing late to serve both locals and the millions of tourists passing through.

The company combines a traditional western retail store with an in-house custom apparel operation called SwiftWear. The retail side stocks western clothing, footwear, tack, gifts, souvenirs, toys, cowboy hats, knives, and collectibles. SwiftWear provides full-color direct-to-garment (DTG) printing on garments such as Bella Canvas t-shirts, offering fast turnaround with in-store service while customers wait. Orders range from single pieces to thousands.

Customers include tourists visiting Yellowstone and Grand Teton, local residents, businesses, teams, and event organizers seeking custom branded apparel. The shop also houses "Country's Cowboys Corner," an officially licensed University of Wyoming Cowboys gift and souvenir shop, serving collegiate fans.

Horn's stated mission is to master future technology to preserve small-town American business. The company emphasizes speed and convenience, promoting same-day custom printing as a differentiator in a rural market.
